body:
The web client only syncs on mount and after its own pushes — there is no
periodic pull, no visibilitychange/focus/online re-sync, and no manual refresh
control (useSync.refresh() exists but nothing calls it except the mount effect
and post-leave cleanup). A tab left open during a shared shopping trip never
sees the collaborator's checks/adds; the header happily reports "Synced 40 min
ago" (T-54's ticking label) with no way to act on it short of a full reload.

The server design (§10) says sync is client-initiated "on reconnect, on
foreground, or manual" — the web client currently implements none of the
three. Android has all three (15-min periodic WorkManager, foreground
expedited sync, pull-to-refresh, T-36).

Fix in useSync/AppShell:
- re-sync on document visibilitychange → visible and on window 'online';
- a modest interval while the tab is visible (e.g. 60–120 s; skip while a
  runSync is already in flight);
- make the SyncIndicator (or a button beside it) clickable as a manual
  refresh.

Files: web/src/hooks/useSync.ts, web/src/components/SyncIndicator.tsx,
web/src/components/AppShell.tsx (+ tests).
title: Web: never re-syncs while open — collaborator changes invisible until reload (no poll/focus/manual refresh)
